extension.summary: Full-screen 2026 Rave UI for Rave Player, with Spinning Surprise.
Full-screen 2026 Rave UI for Rave Player, with Spinning Surprise.
extension.description: A proper Kodi window — not an overlay stuck on top of a plugin directory. Big hero art, a vertical D-pad list, 2026 sticker styling and Spinning Surprise: one random tape pack and track, a ≥1.2 second spinning-head reveal, then playback handed to Kodi. Reads the Rave Player add-on's public data modules read-only. Back exits cleanly; the normal plugin lists remain available as the fallback.
